fires_when: A page is shown: a route change, a project switch, or a page shown again from the page cache.
Every click on a button, link, tab, menu item, checkbox, radio or select.
A project is chosen in the workspace switcher.
An email sign-in code is requested. No user context yet.
An email sign-in code is accepted. No user context yet (the next event has it).
An admin chose a managed repository.
A GitHub repository was linked (also when a managed repository is moved to GitHub).
A file was saved in the editor.
A file or folder was deleted.
A file or folder was renamed or moved.
A starter dbt project was created.
A schedule was changed, paused or resumed.
Pipelines was turned on for the project.
A source's settings or credentials were changed.
A pipeline was edited, paused or resumed.
Sync now was pressed (also the first sync after creating).
Explore's models were refreshed by hand.
A question was sent to the agent.
A chart was downloaded as an image.
A conversation was shared with, or unshared from, the project.
Agent keys, model or limits were saved (never the keys).
Someone allowed an AI app to connect to a project.
A connection of an AI app was disconnected.
A personal token was created (never its value).
An admin changed the project's MCP switches.
A document was downloaded as Markdown.
Any other change to data that has no name above.
A request failed (the platform said no or errored).
